data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall strengthening of prior year reserves by GBP 5.443 million gross in 2018. This adverse development is primarily attributed to natural catastrophe events, with the report noting an overall deficit of GBP 9.0m on prior year reserves (net). Specifically, 2016 underwriting year showed a strengthening, while 2014 and 2015 underwriting years showed releases. The 2017 year of account was impacted by 2018 natural catastrophe events (Hawaii volcano, Hurricanes Florence and Michael, California wildfires) with an estimated net exposure of GBP 4m, contributing to the strengthening. However, net exposure to 2017 natural catastrophe events (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria) reduced from GBP 8m to GBP 6.5m, indicating a net release of GBP 1.5m.
raw_causal_phrases: overall deficit of GBP 9.0m on prior year reserves
natural catastrophe losses continued at an above average level
The year is adversely affected by natural catastrophe losses emanating from the 2017 and 2018 calendar years
data.data_quality_notes: The narrative explicitly states a net deficit of GBP 9.0m on prior year reserves, while the calculation from the gross claims development triangle yields a gross strengthening of GBP 5.443m. The gross figure from the triangle is used for 'prior_year_development_gbp_m' as per instructions.
